A FEW THINGS TO KNOW

Open links. Clear expectations.

Are all channels guaranteed to work?

No. Daily refreshes update source metadata and playlists; they do not playback-test every stream. Some links may be offline or region restricted.

Why does one channel have several streams?

Channels can have alternative stream URLs and quality levels. Duplicate channel-and-URL pairs are removed within each playlist.

How are languages and categories chosen?

We use iptv-org’s feed and channel metadata. English and other languages can include multilingual feeds. Farsi playlists contain only feeds marked exclusively Farsi.

Where does this data come from?

The community behind iptv-org maintains the stream links. Open TV Atlas provides a language/category/quality directory built from that data. We are independent and do not host video streams.
